name: Intellij-idea
tagline: Helps you write code faster with tools that eliminate tedious tasks and let you focus on what matters – building great software.
description: IntelliJ IDEA helps you write code faster with tools that eliminate tedious tasks and let you focus on what matters – building great software.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  app:
    image: linuxserver/intellij-idea:42026.2.3@sha256:c8e124dec890657d5010cf07a18e8790a9e1ded61d52c45fc3418cd3a3a76d0e
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      PUID: $PUID
      PGID: $PGID
      TZ: $TZ
    ports:
      - target: 3000
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
      - target: 3001
        published: 3001
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/config
        target: /config
